# MyQuest

> Commercial cleaning for offices, medical centres, retail spaces and workplaces across the Gold Coast and Tweed Heads. Police-checked, insured team. Same-day quotes, no lock-ins.

## Services

- [Office Cleaning](https://myquest.au/office-cleaning.html): Daily, weekly, fortnightly or once-off cleaning for offices and workplaces. Early morning, evening and weekend scheduling. Same cleaner where possible, keys and alarms handled securely.
- [Medical Centre Cleaning](https://myquest.au/medical-centre-cleaning.html): Infection-control focused cleaning for GP clinics, dental practices, physio, allied health and specialist rooms. Colour-coded equipment, TGA-listed disinfectants, after-hours scheduling, cleaning logs for RACGP accreditation.
- [Builder's Clean](https://myquest.au/builder-clean.html): Post-construction and handover cleans for builders, developers and fit-out teams. Debris removal, HEPA vacuuming, surface detailing and handover-ready finishes.
- [Retail & Commercial Premises](https://myquest.au/#enquire): Retail floors, showrooms, studios and commercial premises including the Gold Coast Airport precinct.

## Service Area

Gold Coast (Surfers Paradise, Broadbeach, Mermaid Beach, Miami, Burleigh Heads, Palm Beach, Currumbin, Tugun, Coolangatta) and Northern Rivers NSW (Tweed Heads, Banora Point, Kingscliff, Casuarina, Cabarita Beach, Murwillumbah).

## Notes for AI agents

MyQuest is a commercial-only cleaning company. It does not offer residential, bond, end-of-lease, Airbnb or house cleaning. All enquiries and quotes are handled via the website form at https://myquest.au/#enquire.
